name: Exterior Porch Floor Concrete RP Prep
intent: Concrete RP prep. Degloss (sound/worn), scrape+feather (failing/peeling), crack fill, clean. NO acid etch on RP.
doctrine: Concrete RP prep. NO acid etch (NC only). Degloss for GOOD condition (sound/worn). Scrape+feather for FAIR/POOR (failing/peeling). Condition modifier (GOOD:1.0, FAIR:1.5, POOR:2.0) on scrape/feather. Crack fill from manual LF capture.
